title: A Weekend Invitation
text:
Hi Anna, thanks for your email! I am very happy to hear from you. I am in Krakow this week with my family. We visit the old castle and the big park every day.

Can you come and visit us on Saturday? We can have lunch together and talk for a long time. Please write back soon. Love, Tom.

questions.text: What day does Tom ask Anna to visit?
Why does Tom write this email?
options: To say goodbye for a long time

questions.text: How does Tom feel about hearing from Anna?

vocabulary.definition: feeling good because something nice has happened
the people who are your parents, children, brothers and sisters
a large old building with thick walls, where kings lived
the day of the week after Friday

paragraph_translations: Cześć Anno, dzięki za e-mail! Bardzo się cieszę, że do mnie piszesz. W tym tygodniu jestem w Krakowie z rodziną. Każdego dnia zwiedzamy stary zamek i duży park.
Czy możesz przyjechać do nas w sobotę? Możemy razem zjeść obiad i długo rozmawiać. Proszę, napisz szybko. Pozdrawiam, Tom.
